meta.title: Refund policy | Imagine PPTP Prints
meta.description: How Imagine PPTP Prints handles reprints, refunds and cancellations for custom orders.

sections.title: Our guarantee
sections.body: If you’re not happy with the print quality of your order, we’ll reprint it or refund you.

sections.title: What’s covered
sections.body: We cover problems with how we printed your order: misprints, wrong or faded colors, smudges or peeling. We also cover items that don’t match the proof you approved in size, quantity or placement.

sections.title: What isn’t covered
sections.body: We custom-make every order, so we can’t refund or exchange items that match the proof you approved. That includes spelling or design mistakes in an approved proof, sizes you chose, or a change of mind after printing.

sections.title: How to ask for a reprint or refund
sections.body: Contact us as soon as you can after pickup or delivery. Send your name, the order details and a photo of the problem. We may ask to see or collect the items. We’ll tell you whether we’ll reprint or refund, and when.

sections.title: Cancelling an order
sections.body: You can cancel for a full refund until you approve the proof. After printing starts, we can only refund the part of the order we haven’t printed yet.

sections.title: How refunds are paid
sections.body: When possible, refunds go back to the way you paid.
